source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice long questions written from Unit 6 (PDF 165-219), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh Unit 6 (Conics (TOC: 'Conic Section'; unit opener printed 'Conics')) ke poore unit se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke Section-II ke sawal ke hisse ki shakal mein: har sawal 5 number ka hai (lamba sawal, saboot (proof) ya derivation). Har sawal poore qadmon ke saath hal kiya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Prove that \(x^{2} + y^{2} + 2gx + 2fy + c = 0\) represents a circle with centre \((-g, -f)\) and radius \(\sqrt{g^{2} + f^{2} - c}\) when \(g^{2} + f^{2} - c > 0\). Hence find the centre and radius of \(x^{2} + y^{2} - 6x + 10y - 2 = 0\). (5 marks)
(Saabit karein ke \(x^{2} + y^{2} + 2gx + 2fy + c = 0\) circle hai jis ka centre \((-g, -f)\) aur radius \(\sqrt{g^{2} + f^{2} - c}\) hai (jab \(g^{2} + f^{2} - c > 0\)). Phir \(x^{2} + y^{2} - 6x + 10y - 2 = 0\) ka centre aur radius maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: x aur y mein complete square karein aur standard form se muqabla karein.

book_ref.quote: where \(g, f, c \in \mathbb{R}\) represents a circle.

steps: Standard form: centre \((-g, -f)\), radius \(\sqrt{g^{2} + f^{2} - c}\)

blocks.prompt:
2 A point moves so that the sum of the squares of its distances from \(A(0, 2)\) and \(B(4, 0)\) is 20. Prove that its locus is a circle and find its centre and radius. (5 marks)
(Aik point is tarah chalta hai ke \(A(0, 2)\) aur \(B(4, 0)\) se us ke faslon ke squares ka majmua 20 hai. Saabit karein ke locus circle hai aur centre, radius maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: P(x, y) lein, shart ko distance formula se likhein, simplify karein, phir working rule lagayein.

book_ref.quote: To find the centre and radius of a circle from its general equation, follow these steps:

blocks.final_answer: Locus circle \(x^{2} + y^{2} - 4x - 2y = 0\) hai: centre \((2, 1)\), radius \(\sqrt{5}\).

blocks.prompt:
3 Prove that the equation of the circle with \(A(x_{1}, y_{1})\) and \(B(x_{2}, y_{2})\) as ends of a diameter is \((x - x_{1})(x - x_{2}) + (y - y_{1})(y - y_{2}) = 0\). Hence find the circle on the diameter joining \((0, -3)\) and \((4, 5)\), with its centre and radius. (5 marks)
(Saabit karein ke diameter ke siron \(A(x_{1}, y_{1})\), \(B(x_{2}, y_{2})\) wale circle ki equation \((x - x_{1})(x - x_{2}) + (y - y_{1})(y - y_{2}) = 0\) hai. Phir \((0, -3)\) aur \((4, 5)\) wale diameter ka circle, centre aur radius maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Semicircle ka angle right angle hai, is liye AP aur BP perpendicular hain.

book_ref.quote: This is the required equation of the circle.

steps: Circle ke point \(P(x, y)\) par \(\angle APB = 90^{\circ}\): \(m_{1}m_{2} = -1\)

blocks.prompt:
4 Find the equation of the circle passing through \((1, 1)\), \((2, -1)\) and \((3, 2)\). Also find its centre and radius. (5 marks)
(\((1, 1)\), \((2, -1)\) aur \((3, 2)\) se guzarne wale circle ki equation, centre aur radius maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Har point general form ko satisfy karta hai; teen equations se g, f, c nikalein.

book_ref.quote: If three non-collinear points through which a circle passes are given

blocks.prompt:
5 Find the equation of the circle passing through \((2, 3)\) and \((4, 5)\) and having its centre on the line \(x - 2y + 2 = 0\). (5 marks)
(\((2, 3)\) aur \((4, 5)\) se guzarne wala circle jis ka centre line \(x - 2y + 2 = 0\) par ho, us ki equation maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Do points se do equations; centre \((-g, -f)\) line par hone se teesri.

book_ref.quote: Case-2: A Circle Passing through Two Points and Having its Centre on a Given Line

blocks.prompt:
6 Find the equation of the circle passing through \((3, -2)\) and touching the line \(x + y - 3 = 0\) at \((1, 2)\). (5 marks)
(Woh circle jo \((3, -2)\) se guzre aur line \(x + y - 3 = 0\) ko \((1, 2)\) par chhooye, us ki equation maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Point of contact circle par hai, aur us par normal centre se guzarta hai.

book_ref.quote: Case 3: A Circle Passing through Two Points and having Tangent at One of These Points

steps: \((1, 2)\) par normal \(x - y + 1 = 0\) centre se guzarta hai: \(g = f + 1\)

blocks.prompt:
7 Find the equations of the circles passing through \(A(2, 1)\) and \(B(2, -1)\) and touching the line \(x - y - 5 = 0\). (5 marks)
(\(A(2, 1)\) aur \(B(2, -1)\) se guzarne wale aur line \(x - y - 5 = 0\) ko chhoone wale circles ki equations maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Centre A aur B se barabar fasle par hai, aur line se us ka fasla radius ke barabar hai.

book_ref.quote: Case 4: A Circle Passing through Two Points and Touching a Given Line

blocks.prompt:
8 Prove that the tangent to \(x^{2} + y^{2} + 2gx + 2fy + c = 0\) at \((x_{1}, y_{1})\) is \(xx_{1} + yy_{1} + g(x + x_{1}) + f(y + y_{1}) + c = 0\). Hence find the tangent and normal to \(x^{2} + y^{2} - 4x + 2y - 20 = 0\) at \((5, 3)\). (5 marks)
(Saabit karein ke \(x^{2} + y^{2} + 2gx + 2fy + c = 0\) ka \((x_{1}, y_{1})\) par tangent \(xx_{1} + yy_{1} + g(x + x_{1}) + f(y + y_{1}) + c = 0\) hai. Phir \(x^{2} + y^{2} - 4x + 2y - 20 = 0\) ke \((5, 3)\) par tangent aur normal maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Implicit differentiation, point-slope form, phir point ka circle par hona istemal karein.

book_ref.quote: Substituting equation (4) into equation (3) and rearranging gives the required equation:

steps: Point-slope form khol kar: \(xx_{1} + yy_{1} + gx + fy = x_{1}^{2} + y_{1}^{2} + gx_{1} + fy_{1}\)
\(gx_{1} + fy_{1}\) jama, right side \(= -c\): tangent saabit

blocks.prompt:
9 Prove that \(P(x_{1}, y_{1})\) lies outside, on or inside \(x^{2} + y^{2} + 2gx + 2fy + c = 0\) according as \(x_{1}^{2} + y_{1}^{2} + 2gx_{1} + 2fy_{1} + c \gtreqless 0\). Hence find the positions of \((4, 6)\), \((1, 1)\) and \((7, 2)\) with respect to \(x^{2} + y^{2} - 2x - 4y - 20 = 0\). (5 marks)
(Saabit karein ke \(P(x_{1}, y_{1})\) circle ke bahar, upar ya andar hai jab \(x_{1}^{2} + y_{1}^{2} + 2gx_{1} + 2fy_{1} + c \gtreqless 0\). Phir \((4, 6)\), \((1, 1)\), \((7, 2)\) ki position \(x^{2} + y^{2} - 2x - 4y - 20 = 0\) ke lehaz se batayein.)
blocks.explanation: |CP| ka radius se muqabla karein aur square lein (dono non-negative).

book_ref.quote: Positive: outside. Zero: on the circle. Negative: inside.

blocks.final_answer: Saabit hua. \((4, 6)\) circle par, \((1, 1)\) andar, \((7, 2)\) bahar.

blocks.prompt:
10 Show that \(y = mx + c\) touches \(x^{2} + y^{2} = a^{2}\) if \(c^{2} = a^{2}(1 + m^{2})\). Hence find the tangents to \(x^{2} + y^{2} = 25\) with slope 2 and their points of contact. (5 marks)
(Dikhayein ke \(y = mx + c\) circle \(x^{2} + y^{2} = a^{2}\) ko chhooti hai agar \(c^{2} = a^{2}(1 + m^{2})\). Phir \(x^{2} + y^{2} = 25\) ke slope 2 wale tangents aur un ke points of contact maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Line ko circle mein rakhein; tangent ke liye barabar roots (discriminant zero).

book_ref.quote: For the tangent \(y = mx + a\sqrt{1 + m^{2}}\), the quadratic equation (3) has equal roots given by:

blocks.prompt:
11 Find the equations of the tangents to \(x^{2} + y^{2} - 4x + 6y - 12 = 0\) which are perpendicular to the line \(3x + 4y = 0\). Also find their points of contact. (5 marks)
(\(x^{2} + y^{2} - 4x + 6y - 12 = 0\) ke woh tangents jo line \(3x + 4y = 0\) ke perpendicular hon, aur un ke points of contact maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Centre se fasla = radius; point of contact centre se perpendicular ka foot hai.

book_ref.quote: Hence, the condition for tangency is that the distance

blocks.prompt:
12 Find the equations of the tangents drawn from \((7, 1)\) to the circle \(x^{2} + y^{2} = 25\), their points of contact, and verify that the chord of contact is \(7x + y = 25\). (5 marks)
(\((7, 1)\) se \(x^{2} + y^{2} = 25\) par tangents, un ke points of contact maloom karein, aur tasdeeq karein ke chord of contact \(7x + y = 25\) hai.)
blocks.explanation: Point se slope m wali line lein aur centre se fasla radius ke barabar rakhein.

book_ref.quote: Two tangents can be drawn to a circle from any point

steps: Chord of contact \(7x + y = 25\), dono points is par hain

blocks.prompt:
13 Prove that the length of the tangent from \(P(x_{1}, y_{1})\) to \(x^{2} + y^{2} + 2gx + 2fy + c = 0\) is \(\sqrt{x_{1}^{2} + y_{1}^{2} + 2gx_{1} + 2fy_{1} + c}\). Hence find the length of the tangent from \((6, -1)\) to \(x^{2} + y^{2} + 2x - 6y - 15 = 0\). (5 marks)
(Saabit karein ke \(P(x_{1}, y_{1})\) se circle tak tangent ki lambai \(\sqrt{x_{1}^{2} + y_{1}^{2} + 2gx_{1} + 2fy_{1} + c}\) hai. Phir \((6, -1)\) se \(x^{2} + y^{2} + 2x - 6y - 15 = 0\) tak lambai maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Point of contact par radius tangent ke perpendicular hai: Pythagoras lagayein.

book_ref.quote: The length of the tangent drawn from a point

blocks.prompt:
14 Find the equation of the parabola with focus \((1, 2)\) and directrix \(x + y + 1 = 0\), and verify that its vertex \((0, 1)\) lies on it. (5 marks)
(Focus \((1, 2)\) aur directrix \(x + y + 1 = 0\) wale parabola ki equation maloom karein aur tasdeeq karein ke vertex \((0, 1)\) is par hai.)
blocks.explanation: |PF| = |PM| lagayein (point se line ka fasla).

book_ref.quote: A Parabola is the locus of a point which moves in a plane

blocks.prompt:
15 With focus \(F(a, 0)\) and directrix \(x = -a\), derive the standard equation \(y^{2} = 4ax\) of the parabola. Verify for \(y^{2} = 4x\) that the point \((4, 4)\) is equidistant from the focus and the directrix. (5 marks)
(Focus \(F(a, 0)\) aur directrix \(x = -a\) se parabola ki standard equation \(y^{2} = 4ax\) derive karein. \(y^{2} = 4x\) ke liye tasdeeq karein ke \((4, 4)\) focus aur directrix se barabar fasle par hai.)
blocks.explanation: P(x, y) ke liye |PF| = |PM| likhein, square karke simplify karein.

book_ref.quote: This is the standard equation of the parabola.

blocks.prompt:
16 Find the vertex, focus, axis, directrix and length of latus rectum of the parabola \(x^{2} + 6x - 8y + 1 = 0\), and describe its graph. (5 marks)
(Parabola \(x^{2} + 6x - 8y + 1 = 0\) ka vertex, focus, axis, directrix aur latus rectum ki lambai maloom karein aur graph bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: x mein complete square karein aur X = x - h, Y = y - k lein.

book_ref.quote: By taking the directrix on the right side of the focus, or below or above the focus

steps: Latus rectum 8; upar ki taraf khulta hai
blocks.final_answer: Vertex \((-3, -1)\), focus \((-3, 1)\), axis \(x = -3\), directrix \(y = -3\), latus rectum 8, upar khulta hai.

blocks.prompt:
17 Find the vertex, focus, axis, directrix and length of latus rectum of \(y^{2} - 4y - 12x + 40 = 0\). (5 marks)
(\(y^{2} - 4y - 12x + 40 = 0\) ka vertex, focus, axis, directrix aur latus rectum maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: y mein complete square; right side par x ka coefficient bahar nikalein.

book_ref.quote: The table below summarizes the key features of all four forms.

steps: Latus rectum 12; daen taraf khulta hai
blocks.final_answer: Vertex \((3, 2)\), focus \((6, 2)\), axis \(y = 2\), directrix \(x = 0\), latus rectum 12.

blocks.prompt:
18 Prove that \(y = mx + c\) is a tangent to \(y^{2} = 4ax\) if \(c = \frac{a}{m}\). Hence find the tangent to \(y^{2} = 6x\) with slope \(\frac{3}{2}\) and its point of contact. (5 marks)
(Saabit karein ke \(y = mx + c\) parabola \(y^{2} = 4ax\) ka tangent hai agar \(c = \frac{a}{m}\). Phir \(y^{2} = 6x\) ka slope \(\frac{3}{2}\) wala tangent aur point of contact maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Line ko parabola mein rakhein aur discriminant zero karein.

book_ref.quote: the required condition for the line

blocks.final_answer: Saabit hua. Tangent \(3x - 2y + 2 = 0\), point of contact \(\left(\frac{2}{3}, 2\right)\).

blocks.prompt:
19 Taking the foci at \(F'(-c, 0)\), \(F(c, 0)\) and the constant sum of distances \(2a\), derive the standard equation \(\frac{x^{2}}{a^{2}} + \frac{y^{2}}{b^{2}} = 1\) of the ellipse, where \(b^{2} = a^{2} - c^{2}\). (5 marks)
(Foci \(F'(-c, 0)\), \(F(c, 0)\) aur faslon ka majmua \(2a\) le kar ellipse ki standard equation \(\frac{x^{2}}{a^{2}} + \frac{y^{2}}{b^{2}} = 1\) derive karein, jahan \(b^{2} = a^{2} - c^{2}\).)
blocks.explanation: Aik radical alag, square; doosra radical alag, phir square.

book_ref.quote: To simplify, isolate one radical and square both sides

steps: Square, cancel: \(a\sqrt{(x - c)^{2} + y^{2}} = a^{2} - cx\)

blocks.prompt:
20 Find the centre, foci, eccentricity, vertices and directrices of the ellipse \(9x^{2} + 4y^{2} + 18x - 16y - 11 = 0\). (5 marks)
(Ellipse \(9x^{2} + 4y^{2} + 18x - 16y - 11 = 0\) ka centre, foci, eccentricity, vertices aur directrices maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Complete squares, right side 1 banayein, phir h, k, a, b parhein.

book_ref.quote: describes a vertical ellipse with foci at

blocks.prompt:
21 Find the equation of the ellipse with foci \((-1, 3)\) and \((5, 3)\) and major axis of length 10. Also find its vertices, co-vertices and eccentricity. (5 marks)
(Foci \((-1, 3)\), \((5, 3)\) aur major axis lambai 10 wale ellipse ki equation, vertices, co-vertices aur eccentricity maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Centre = foci ka mid-point; c = centre se focus; b^2 = a^2 - c^2.

book_ref.quote: describes a horizontal ellipse with foci at

blocks.prompt:
22 Show that \(y = mx + c\) touches \(\frac{x^{2}}{a^{2}} + \frac{y^{2}}{b^{2}} = 1\) if \(c^{2} = a^{2}m^{2} + b^{2}\). Hence find the tangents to \(\frac{x^{2}}{8} + \frac{y^{2}}{4} = 1\) with slope \(-2\) and their points of contact. (5 marks)
(Dikhayein ke \(y = mx + c\) ellipse ko chhooti hai agar \(c^{2} = a^{2}m^{2} + b^{2}\). Phir \(\frac{x^{2}}{8} + \frac{y^{2}}{4} = 1\) ke slope \(-2\) wale tangents aur points of contact maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Line rakhein, denominators hatayein, discriminant zero; barabar root se point.

book_ref.quote: Tangency occurs when the quadratic in \(x\) has equal roots.

blocks.prompt:
23 Taking the foci at \(F'(-c, 0)\), \(F(c, 0)\) and \(|PF'| - |PF| = \pm 2a\), derive the standard equation \(\frac{x^{2}}{a^{2}} - \frac{y^{2}}{b^{2}} = 1\) of the hyperbola, where \(c^{2} = a^{2} + b^{2}\). (5 marks)
(Foci \(F'(-c, 0)\), \(F(c, 0)\) aur \(|PF'| - |PF| = \pm 2a\) le kar hyperbola ki standard equation \(\frac{x^{2}}{a^{2}} - \frac{y^{2}}{b^{2}} = 1\) derive karein, jahan \(c^{2} = a^{2} + b^{2}\).)
blocks.explanation: Aik radical alag karke do dafa square; triangle inequality se a < c.

book_ref.quote: Let the absolute value of constant difference of distances

steps: Square, cancel: \(\mp a\sqrt{(x - c)^{2} + y^{2}} = a^{2} - cx\)

blocks.prompt:
24 Find the centre, foci, eccentricity, vertices, directrices and asymptotes of \(4x^{2} - 9y^{2} - 16x - 54y - 101 = 0\). (5 marks)
(\(4x^{2} - 9y^{2} - 16x - 54y - 101 = 0\) ka centre, foci, eccentricity, vertices, directrices aur asymptotes maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Complete squares; positive term direction batata hai aur us ka denominator a^2 hai.

book_ref.quote: describes a hyperbola with foci at the points \(F'(h - c, k)\)

blocks.prompt:
25 Find the equation of the hyperbola with foci \((-3, 1)\) and \((-3, -11)\) and one vertex \((-3, -1)\). Also find its eccentricity and asymptotes. (5 marks)
(Foci \((-3, 1)\), \((-3, -11)\) aur aik vertex \((-3, -1)\) wale hyperbola ki equation, eccentricity aur asymptotes maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Centre = foci ka mid-point; c aur a centre se fasle; b^2 = c^2 - a^2.

book_ref.quote: and the vertices are located at \((h, k \pm a)\)

blocks.prompt:
26 Find the equations of the tangents to the hyperbola \(7x^{2} - 2y^{2} = 14\) that pass through the point \((1, -1)\), and their points of contact. (5 marks)
(Hyperbola \(7x^{2} - 2y^{2} = 14\) ke woh tangents jo point \((1, -1)\) se guzarte hain, aur un ke points of contact maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: y = mx ± sqrt(a^2 m^2 - b^2) lein, point se guzarayein, sahi sign rakhein.

book_ref.quote: provided \(a^2m^2 > b^2\).

blocks.prompt:
27 A comet moves on a parabolic orbit with the Sun at the focus. When the comet is 80 million km from the Sun, the line joining them makes an angle of \(45^{\circ}\) with the axis (the comet being beyond the Sun, away from the vertex). How close will the comet come to the Sun? (5 marks)
(Aik comet parabolic madar par hai, Sooraj focus par. Jab comet Sooraj se 80 million km door hai to un ko milane wali line axis se \(45^{\circ}\) ka angle banati hai (comet Sooraj se aage, vertex se door). Comet Sooraj ke kitna qareeb aayega?)
blocks.explanation: Focus ke sab se qareeb vertex hai, fasla a; maloom point se a nikalein.

book_ref.quote: Choose the axes so that the conic has a standard equation

blocks.final_answer: Comet Sooraj se \(20(2 - \sqrt{2}) \approx 11.72\) million km tak qareeb aayega.

blocks.prompt:
28 The cable of a suspension bridge hangs as a parabola. The span is 300 m, the tops of the towers are 60 m above the road and the lowest point of the cable is 15 m above the road. Find the equation of the cable and the length of the vertical chain 50 m from a tower. (5 marks)
(Suspension bridge ki cable parabola hai. Span 300 m, towers ki choti sarak se 60 m upar aur cable ka sab se neeche wala point sarak se 15 m upar hai. Cable ki equation aur tower se 50 m par vertical chain ki lambai maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Vertex cable ke sab se neeche wale point par; tower ki choti se 4a; sarak tak 15 m jama karein.

book_ref.quote: Every problem follows the same four steps

blocks.prompt:
29 A satellite's elliptical orbit has the Earth's centre at one focus; its major and minor axes are 10000 km and 8000 km. Find the greatest and least distances from the Earth's centre and the eccentricity, and verify \(e = \frac{A - P}{A + P}\). (5 marks)
(Satellite ke elliptical madar ke aik focus par Earth ka centre hai; major aur minor axes 10000 km aur 8000 km hain. Zyada se zyada aur kam se kam fasla aur eccentricity maloom karein, aur \(e = \frac{A - P}{A + P}\) ki tasdeeq karein.)
blocks.explanation: Aadhe axes lein; c = sqrt(a^2 - b^2); door vertex a + c, qareeb a - c.

book_ref.quote: Every problem follows the same four steps

blocks.final_answer: Zyada se zyada 8000 km, kam se kam 2000 km, \(e = 0.6\).
